svg.text: The 2017 first round, pick by pick: points per game, with goals above expected
30 first-round skaters (No. 26 Oettinger is a goalie). Career NHL points per game; GAx = career goals minus xG.
His -25.3 GAx is the worst in the round. 0.34 points per game ranks 19th of 30, ahead of all but two defensemen.
Source: MoneyPuck career totals through 2025-26, regular season. 25-26 column = points in games last season.
